config.format: JSON <= 128KiB via local.load_config, SHA must equal CONFIG_SHA, deny unknown fields

fields.source_identity_sha256: root-supplied qualified native source identity, recorded verbatim
fields.binaries: {preparer, sq8, generation, publisher, baseline}: each {path (absolute),bytes,sha256}, <=256MiB, authenticated before spawn and after each stage (run_stage does this); roles: prepare_cohere_native_cohort, build_sq8_source example (modes normalize/fit/build), build_two_bit_generation, publish_two_bit_generation, check_cohere_native_baseline
fields.shards: [2] {publisher_path:'en/0000.parquet'|'en/0001.parquet', path (absolute local), bytes, sha256}; whole bodies already authenticated by root; passed through to the preparer which re-authenticates them; Python never opens/decodes Parquet
fields.document_id_column: string passed to preparer config (embedding column fixed 'emb')
fields.preparer_limits: {modeled_memory_bytes,max_footer_bytes,max_row_group_rows,max_row_group_compressed_bytes,max_row_group_uncompressed_bytes,batch_rows,max_batch_bytes,max_id_bytes} copied into preparer config; runner fixes cpu_limit=4, actual_memory_bytes=8GiB, swap_bytes=0, scratch_bytes=8GiB, timeout_seconds=2400 (the preparer's own frozen envelope)
fields.payload_cap_bytes: MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES passed to normalize/fit/build_sq8_source and MAX_MEMORY_BYTES to build_two_bit_generation
fields.publisher_limits: all 10 TwoBitGenerationLimits fields, explicit, forwarded to the publisher config
fields.phase_seconds: {prepare<=2400,normalize<=600,fit<=1800,sq8<=600,generation<=1200,publish<=600,baseline<=1800}; deadline_seconds<=9600 (root proposal maxima, hard caps in helper)
fields.admission: {path,bytes,sha256} root-supplied completed admission receipt (<=64KiB), schema borsuk-cohere-native-preflight-v1-admission; REPLACES authority_pending/qualification; rejected before ANY native call

output_layout: NEW_OUTPUT created exclusively (mkdir exist_ok=False, outside /mnt/hierarchical-100k); never overwritten/resumed. Children: config.json, prepared/ (preparer NEW_OUTPUT_DIR: corpus.f32 queries.f32 truth.u64 ... complete.json), normalized.f32, order.u64, sq8.bin, store/ (LocalFileSystem root: semantic/objects/<sq8_sha256> staged copy + semantic/index/ head), generation/, configs/*.json (per-stage frozen configs/invocation specs), publish-receipt.json, scratch/, baseline-result.jsonl, <stage>.log/-stage.json/-closure.json/-stage-receipt.json/-unit.log (supervisor), execution-receipt.json, terminal.json (last, inventory of every file with bytes+sha256)

serial_native_calls.name: prepare
serial_native_calls.config: runner-generated preparer config; output_parent = {path: OUT, device, inode} of the actual created directory
serial_native_calls.reads: prepared/complete.json only (native marker receipt: outputs[].name/bytes/sha256 for corpus.f32, queries.f32, truth.u64)
serial_native_calls.checks: byte lengths equal the fixed constants; each output streamed through local.authenticate against the receipt SHA; contents never decoded

serial_native_calls.name: normalize
serial_native_calls.argv: sq8 normalize prepared/corpus.f32 CORPUS_SHA 100000 1024 CAP OUT/normalized.f32
serial_native_calls.reads: stdout JSON {normalized_sha256}; output re-authenticated by streaming SHA AND must be exactly ROWS*DIMS*4 = 409600000 bytes before fit starts

serial_native_calls.name: fit
serial_native_calls.argv: sq8 fit OUT/normalized.f32 NORM_SHA 100000 1024 CAP OUT/order.u64
serial_native_calls.reads: stdout JSON {order_sha256,rows:100000}; order.u64 must be 800000 bytes with that SHA

serial_native_calls.name: sq8
serial_native_calls.argv: sq8 OUT/normalized.f32 NORM_SHA 1024 OUT/order.u64 ORDER_SHA CAP OUT/sq8.bin
serial_native_calls.reads: stdout JSON {low[1024],step[1024],sq8_sha256,rows}; low/step kept as raw JSON number tokens (never float-reserialized)

serial_native_calls.name: stage-sq8 (Python, no native process)
serial_native_calls.action: streamed authenticated publication.transfer of sq8.bin to store/semantic/objects/<sq8_sha256>, then ETag = '"%x-%x-%x"' % (st_ino, st_mtime_ns//1000, st_size) from the FINAL key (object_store 0.14.1 local.rs get_etag, verified in the locked registry source); no later mutation/touch

serial_native_calls.name: generation
serial_native_calls.config: build_two_bit_generation config: discovery semantic, semantic_profile native100k, order{path,sha256}, raw=normalized, sq8, rows 100000, dimensions 1024, generation 1, base_epoch 0, low, step, sq8_object_key, sq8_etag

serial_native_calls.name: publish
serial_native_calls.config: borsuk-two-bit-local-publication-config-v1: root{path: OUT/generation, sha256}, store_root OUT/store, prefix semantic/index, limits=publisher_limits
serial_native_calls.reads: publish-receipt.json (native receipt: root_sha256, generation 1, control_epoch, metadata_prefix); log is legitimately EMPTY -> the imported silent-success handling

serial_native_calls.name: baseline
serial_native_calls.config: borsuk-cohere-native-baseline-config-v1: store_root OUT/store, generation_prefix=receipt.metadata_prefix, generation_root_sha256, scratch_parent OUT/scratch, requests=prepared/queries.f32 (unchanged original), truth=prepared/truth.u64, native_source{source_sha256=NORM_SHA, sq8_sha256, source_order_sha256 from generation/plane/manifest.json}, max_memory_bytes=512MiB
serial_native_calls.reads: nothing semantic: baseline-result.jsonl and stdout are pinned (bytes+sha256) as opaque bytes

per_call_closure: native_stage + stage_closure-style verification of the recorded closure: original exit 0, exact argv, unit drained, cgroup drained, inactive unit, memory.max<=cap, swap 0, exact affinity, no new OOM, wall<=phase budget, retained log byte-identical; failures keep partial evidence

resource_seam.note: scratch counted over the whole NEW_OUTPUT (run_stage directory_bytes(out)); timeouts per phase_seconds, whole run deadline_seconds; costs/deadlines are root-prospective, nothing hard-coded beyond the preparer's own 2400s

terminal_states.NATIVE_CHAIN_CLOSED: all 7 native calls exit 0 with closed/drained units and authenticated outputs; makes NO quality claim (baseline bytes pinned, not read)
terminal_states.BASELINE_NONZERO_EXIT: baseline native exit != 0 after a clean closed unit; native exit code recorded verbatim, no interpretation
terminal_states.INVALID: pending/pin/binary/input mismatch, resource/cgroup/OOM/timeout/log-cap, unit not drained, receipt/length/SHA mismatch, SIGTERM; error + error_type recorded; completed stage evidence preserved; later stages not run
terminal_states.files: execution-receipt.json then terminal.json (status, complete, exit code 0 only for NATIVE_CHAIN_CLOSED, inventory)

never: edits to native source or the 9b656e05 frozen glue
tests: --self-check only: mocked native_stage/owned boundary + a fake native tree; negatives for pending flag, wrong binary SHA, short/oversize outputs, ETag formula vs a real temp file stat, occupied output, nonzero/closure failures, terminal inventory; no Rust, no network

implementation_notes.argv_exact: normalize/fit/sq8 argv verified against examples/build_sq8_source.rs main (8 args incl. exe); generation = CONFIG SHA MAX_MEMORY NEW_OUTPUT; publisher = CONFIG SHA NEW_RECEIPT; baseline = CONFIG SHA NEW_OUTPUT
implementation_notes.per_stage_config_pin: normalize/fit/sq8 use a runner-written canonical invocation-spec JSON (borsuk-cohere-native-preflight-v1-invocation) as the run_stage config pin
implementation_notes.closure: native_stage verifications plus closure(): exact argv, unit inactive/MainPID 0, drained cgroup, inner CLOSED/complete, memory/peak<=cap, swap 0, exact affinity, no new OOM, wall<=phase
implementation_notes.silent_log: publisher success log is 0 bytes; handled by witness.owned_stage unchanged, 0-byte SHA authenticated and asserted in the self-check
implementation_notes.baseline_nonzero: clean closed unit + plain native exit 1..127 with no OOM/swap -> BASELINE_NONZERO_EXIT (complete=true, exit code 2, native code recorded); everything else INVALID

covers: real orchestration through probe.native_stage + local.run_stage with mocked systemd/cgroup and fixture native programs (tiny geometry via patched constants)
7 calls in order with role/CPU/memory seams (build CPU0-3/8GiB, baseline CPU0/512MiB)
prepare/normalize/fit/sq8/generation/publisher/baseline argv+config consumed by fixture natives with their own assertions (low/step raw tokens, ETag shape, ids, prefixes)

negatives: prep exit/short/sha, normalize sha lie, native exit3, sq8 short, generation root lie, publish mismatch, undrained unit, baseline exit2, pending/binary/shard/column/unknown/limit/phase/qualification/cap pin errors, nooverwrite
source_only_check_receipt.admission_negatives: pending/failed status, source/prior/gate identity, nonzero or bool exit, stage count, unterminated, gate pointer SHA, role/gate binding, role SHA, basename, role swap, unknown/missing fields, old pending-false shortcut, phase/deadline over proposal maxima; every refusal asserts native_stage spy == [] and zero supervisor spawns
source_only_check_receipt.normalized_size_negative: fixture norm-short: authenticated short normalized file whose reported SHA matches -> INVALID after normalize, native_stage spy == [prepare, normalize] (zero fit calls)

not_exercised: real systemd/cgroup, real Rust natives, real Parquet/corpus; terminal inventory hashes every output byte (~1GiB at production size)

fields.gates: {native_publisher (80402, current source, stage_count==6), sq8_builder (89644, prior source), generation_builder (12009, prior source)}: each {session, instance_id, source_identity_sha256, stage_count, stage_exit_statuses (all int 0, len==count), terminated:true, receipt:{path,bytes,sha256} authenticated pointer}
fields.roles: {preparer,publisher,baseline -> native_publisher; sq8 -> sq8_builder; generation -> generation_builder}: each {gate, binary:{path (original), bytes, sha256, local_basename}}

admission_receipt.binding: configured role bytes/sha256 must equal the admitted role Artifact; Path(configured.path).name must equal local_basename (root chooses exact local paths); five admitted SHAs distinct (no role swap)
admission_receipt.scope: helper validates the pinned root admission schema/status/identity/roles and gate exits0/terminated; it does NOT recreate the native assurance verifier. Root creates the receipt only after the closed gates.

durability_note: receipt records that only the publish receipt file and parent dir are fsynced; LocalFileSystem receipt readback is no guarantee that object bodies were fsynced
